criteria: reaches allele1/allele2, waveform inherited, map coverage, in-vivo evidence in BUB1B, in humans, effect size known, cheaply killable

approaches.name: Trans-splicing (SMaRT) of endogenous pre-mRNA
approaches.note: only modality reaching the dead allele; needs 23-38% efficiency

approaches.name: NAD+ precursor (NMN/NR) via SIRT2/K668
approaches.note: only class with in-vivo evidence of raising BubR1; slows the clock it rides on

approaches.name: trans-RNA initiation on endogenous mRNA
approaches.note: Nat Biotechnol Nov 2025; endogenous and in vivo in mouse, but weeks old

approaches.name: CRISPRa at the native BUB1B promoter
approaches.note: not deliverable as therapy; the right experiment for the dosage thesis

approaches.name: Readthrough (ataluren / G418 / ACE-tRNA)
approaches.note: needs a PTC in a surviving transcript: 4 alleles, or 284 with NMD attenuation

approaches.name: Pharmacological chaperone, pseudokinase pocket
approaches.note: no validated tool here; no structure of 766-1050 above 3.8 A

approaches.name: Checkpoint timing extension
approaches.note: only idea reaching the 280 transcript-less alleles; mitotic drugs are cytotoxic

approaches.name: Prime editing, ex vivo
approaches.note: c.3006T>G is a transversion; corrects blood, and MVA's tumours are solid

approaches.name: Senolytics / mTORC1 inhibition
approaches.note: treats accrued damage; p21 effects are bidirectional by tissue

approaches.name: HDAC inhibition to raise acetylation
approaches.note: K250 stabilises and K668 destabilises; net effect unpredictable

approaches.name: circRNA / AAV encoding BubR1
approaches.note: constitutive source fills the anaphase trough

approaches.name: Splice-modulating ASO (TANGO-style)
approaches.note: no poison exon; non-canonical junction flux 0.00% vs SCN1A 4.55%

approaches.name: Neoantigen vaccine
approaches.note: germline variant is in every cell; it would target the patient

rank_default: CRISPRa at the native BUB1B promoter

adjuncts.name: Mosaic selection as an amplifier
adjuncts.note: lowers trans-splicing's bar from holding 23-38% to seeding an expanding clone -- but only in renewing tissue, not the brain

adjuncts.name: Cancer-risk stratification from the map
adjuncts.note: not a therapy; the only clinically actionable output available today, and it needs no new biology
